QuestInfo.name: Checking on Henesys
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. \r\nMeet Chief Stan in Henesys to see how things are going there.
QuestInfo.2: You go to meet Chief Stan in Henesys. He says everything's fine.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 90,000
Can proceed to Checking on El Nath

0.0: We can't rest easy yet,  #h0#. There is more work to be done.
0.1: The Black Mage's resurrection is imminent. The Explorers of the Maple Alliance need to be ready.
0.2: So I want you to check with #bChief Stan#k in Henesys and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.

yes.0: Every town must be prepared, but we have so little time...

1.0: Athena Pierce wants to know what's going on with Henesys?

yes.0: Well, tell her to take her lazy bum outside and look for herself! I'm busy enough without having to keep track of what's going on in my town! But nobody's mentioned anything strange to me...

npc.0: I want you to check with #bChief Stan#k in Henesys and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.
